Purchasing has issued a termination notice for the Model A nomination and all future programmes, and has asked for 30% of upfront tooling and R&D to be returned: INR 3.60 Mn on the quoted figures (30% of INR 12.00 Mn), assuming the quoted amounts were paid in full.
